factorRatings.note: The Infatuation (7.6/10) says this First Hill pizzeria and dive bar from the Taurus Ox team 'doesn't quite compete with pizzerias in other parts of town' on the basics, but its adventurous Lao-influenced pies -- bamboo shoots, lardon, dill, togarashi, pineapple -- make it the most exciting opening the neighborhood has seen, best for late-night slices and beer (open till 1am). Curiocity's opening report (Nov. 2023) confirms the Laotian-pizza concept from the Taurus Ox owners.

WhatNow reported (July 2024) that Capitale Pizzeria -- a pizza-focused sibling of Belltown's La Fontana Siciliana from Rodrigo Parisi and Saulo Cruz -- was taking over the former Boca Pizzeria space on Broadway E, expected to open later in 2024. The restaurant's own menu confirms a globally themed lineup of wood-fired pies named for cities (Capri, Lisboa, Madrid, Napoli, Ankara, Sao Paulo), a distinctive angle, though no critic has yet weighed in on execution.
